description: This file defines the BatchAttributeStep class, a custom ProseMirror step for batch updating node attributes in a document, including methods for applying updates, inverting, mapping, and serialization.

classes.name: BatchAttributeStep
classes.description: A custom ProseMirror Step subclass for batching attribute updates on nodes within a document.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the batch attribute updates to a given document node, returning a new document with updated attributes.

methods.name: updateContent
methods.description: Recursively updates the content of nodes based on the update map, adjusting attributes as specified.

methods.name: invert
methods.description: Creates an inverse step that reverts the attribute updates based on the original document state.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps the step's updates through a document mapping, adjusting positions accordingly.

methods.name: toJSON
methods.description: Serializes the step to a JSON object for storage or transmission.

methods.name: fromJSON
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON object to reconstruct a BatchAttributeStep instance.
